Description: Strict validator is concentrated on DCI 0_0 and 1_0.
TechnicalImpact: 0_1/1_1 cannot be claimed as complete strict control.
RequiredFix: Replace format whitelist with release-pinned contextual schema registry.

Description: DCI 0_1/1_1 sizes are hard-coded sums.
TechnicalImpact: Conditional fields, BWP sizes, carrier indicators, antenna ports, CSI/SRS/CBG state and alignment are wrong for many contexts.
RequiredFix: Implement context-driven field presence, width and alignment engine.

Description: One scalar NSizeGrid drives all frequency-domain widths.
TechnicalImpact: Initial/active UL/DL BWPs and resource-allocation types are conflated.
RequiredFix: Use separate initial/active UL/DL BWP and procedure context.

Description: Payload length becomes the maximum selected format size.
TechnicalImpact: Different monitored DCI sizes and alignment classes are collapsed.
RequiredFix: Return one exact size per format/context and explicit monitored-size alignment groups.

Description: Field layouts use fixed numeric widths.
TechnicalImpact: Optional and RNTI-specific fields are packed even when absent or omitted when required.
RequiredFix: Generate field definitions from DCIContext and pinned 38.212 clauses.

Description: Missing DCI fields silently default to zero.
TechnicalImpact: Malformed scheduler state can generate a valid-looking DCI.
RequiredFix: Require every present field and reject unexpected or missing fields.

Description: Payload writing silently truncates fields at K.
TechnicalImpact: Bit loss can pass unnoticed.
RequiredFix: Assert exact layout sum equals K before packing; no min/truncation.

Description: Field values are floored/clamped to unsigned values.
TechnicalImpact: Negative, fractional and out-of-range values are not rejected.
RequiredFix: Typed range validation per field before serialization.

Description: Short payloads are zero-padded.
TechnicalImpact: Wrong DCI size can decode as a different valid assignment.
RequiredFix: Reject any length mismatch before parsing.

Description: Long payloads are truncated.
TechnicalImpact: Wrong size/context is hidden.
RequiredFix: Reject any length mismatch before parsing.

Description: DCI parser owns a local time-domain allocation table.
TechnicalImpact: RRC time-domain allocation lists and K0/K2 state are bypassed.
RequiredFix: Resolve indices through active RRC/BWP timing context.

Description: Invalid time-domain rows can fall back to the first row.
TechnicalImpact: Invalid control fields become legal grants.
RequiredFix: Fail with typed semantic error.

Description: DCI 1_0 grant builder contains fixed symbol assumptions.
TechnicalImpact: PDSCH resources are not solely determined by decoded field plus RRC table.
RequiredFix: Materialize from decoded field and active PDSCH time-domain allocation list.

Description: HARQ feedback timing is fixed/defaulted.
TechnicalImpact: K1 is not decoded/contextual.
RequiredFix: Resolve PDSCH-to-HARQ timing from DCI and active list.

Description: DCI 0_1 grant builder clamps decoded values.
TechnicalImpact: Invalid SRI/TPMI/rank/ports can become another legal grant.
RequiredFix: Validate exact contextual range and reject.

Description: DCI 0_1 path contains local K2 assumptions.
TechnicalImpact: PUSCH timing can differ from decoded/RRC state.
RequiredFix: Use central timing engine and active PUSCH allocation list.

Description: Strict RNTI support is a short whitelist.
TechnicalImpact: Paging, configured scheduling, TPC and other control procedures are not integrated.
RequiredFix: Implement RNTIProcedureRegistry with search-space/DCI applicability.

Description: RNTI validity is treated as one generic numeric interval.
TechnicalImpact: Special and procedure-specific RNTI semantics are wrong.
RequiredFix: Validate by RNTI type/procedure rather than one range.

Description: Scenario configuration can be treated as control binding authority.
TechnicalImpact: Connected data grants can bypass decoded control.
RequiredFix: Separate transmission intention from decoded control event.

Description: Scenario builder derives size from grid only.
TechnicalImpact: Contextual DCI size alignment is bypassed.
RequiredFix: Require full DCIContext.

Description: TX accepts random/zero/direct configured payload paths near production.
TechnicalImpact: Synthetic control can leak into connected mode.
RequiredFix: Keep direct bits only in isolated calibration factory.

Description: PDCCH payload defaults to 64 bits.
TechnicalImpact: Payload size is not derived from DCI context.
RequiredFix: Require exact K from schema engine.

Description: Default CORESET frequency bitmap is synthesized.
TechnicalImpact: Control resources can differ from RRC/Type0 state.
RequiredFix: Require explicit CORESET definition.

Description: Invalid/missing aggregation level can become AL4.
TechnicalImpact: Candidate location and code rate silently change.
RequiredFix: Validate AL in {1,2,4,8,16}; no default in strict profile.

Description: SI-RNTI/toolbox workaround changes physical RNTI state.
TechnicalImpact: CRC masking/scrambling provenance is ambiguous.
RequiredFix: Use explicit RNTI mask and toolbox adapter without changing semantic RNTI.

Description: Receiver contains a known-location path near blind strict operation.
TechnicalImpact: Oracle candidate indices can be mistaken for blind monitoring.
RequiredFix: Isolate synchronized calibration and prohibit its use in blind strict profile.

Description: Blind flow can fall back to configured resource indices.
TechnicalImpact: Blind detection becomes known-location decoding.
RequiredFix: No fallback; fail if candidate enumeration/extraction fails.

Description: Blind timing may be disabled or externally supplied.
TechnicalImpact: Waveform-only detection is not proven.
RequiredFix: Implement declared synchronization acquisition or use separately named synchronized profile.

Description: Receiver can stop after first CRC pass.
TechnicalImpact: Multiple valid candidates/formats/RNTIs are not resolved deterministically.
RequiredFix: Collect all passes, apply exact ambiguity/procedure rules, then select.

Description: Blind helper receives one RNTI and one format.
TechnicalImpact: It does not perform a configured search across monitored hypotheses.
RequiredFix: Enumerate all legal format-size-RNTI hypotheses per search space.

Description: Candidate table invents CCE index from loop position.
TechnicalImpact: Reported resource provenance is wrong.
RequiredFix: Propagate actual candidate first CCE and full CCE set.

Description: Blind helper uses one configured aggregation level.
TechnicalImpact: Full AL/candidate matrix is not monitored.
RequiredFix: Enumerate configured candidates at AL 1,2,4,8,16.

Description: Type0 resolver is a fixed mini profile.
TechnicalImpact: Most valid pdcch-ConfigSIB1 combinations cannot execute.
RequiredFix: Implement complete selected-release Type0 table resolver.

Description: Type0 AL, candidates and payload are hard-coded.
TechnicalImpact: Initial access is not table/context driven.
RequiredFix: Derive all from Tables 13-x, search-space state and DCI 1_0 SI-RNTI context.

Description: Type0 duration/bitmap assumptions are fixed.
TechnicalImpact: CORESET0 physical location can be wrong.
RequiredFix: Use table values including puncturing/special cases.

Description: Study search-space code accepts aggregation level 32.
TechnicalImpact: Non-NR AL can leak into tests.
RequiredFix: Restrict NR strict to 1,2,4,8,16; move experiments to research profile.

Description: Candidate generation uses a custom hash.
TechnicalImpact: USS CCE candidates differ from TS 38.213.
RequiredFix: Implement Y recursion and candidate equation exactly.

Description: Study CCE-to-REG interleaving is approximate/custom.
TechnicalImpact: REG/CCE resources are wrong.
RequiredFix: Replace with TS 38.211 interleaver.

Description: REG bundle indexing uses 1-based ceil arithmetic.
TechnicalImpact: Bundle boundaries can be off by one.
RequiredFix: Use zero-based bundle=floor(REG/L), then convert only at API boundary.

Description: REG is treated as an arbitrary RE chunk.
TechnicalImpact: NR REG definition one RB x one symbol is violated.
RequiredFix: Represent explicit RB/symbol REG coordinates and DM-RS/data REs.

Description: Detector prunes candidates/ALs using heuristic SINR.
TechnicalImpact: Configured/measured truth can reduce blind hypotheses.
RequiredFix: Monitor all required candidates; complexity shortcuts only in labelled study profile.

Description: Detector contains undefined high-SCS/6G placeholder behavior.
TechnicalImpact: NR strict can execute non-normative assumptions.
RequiredFix: Remove from NR strict; use explicit research numerology interface.

Description: Study decoder allows non-QPSK PDCCH modulation.
TechnicalImpact: PDCCH waveform is non-NR.
RequiredFix: Strict PDCCH modulation is QPSK only.

Description: False-alarm campaign is tiny by default.
TechnicalImpact: No-signal upper bound is statistically meaningless.
RequiredFix: Use target-driven trials and exact one-sided confidence bound.

Description: Strict validation is focused on 1_0/0_0 anchors.
TechnicalImpact: 0_1/1_1 and contextual matrices lack runtime evidence.
RequiredFix: Execute complete declared format/context/AL/RNTI matrix.

Description: Grant validator uses coarse MCS bands.
TechnicalImpact: Decoded DCI semantics do not match active MCS tables.
RequiredFix: Delegate to PDSCH/PUSCH MCS resolver with active table and capability.

Description: Grant validation assumes pre-expanded scalar fields.
TechnicalImpact: Resource-allocation type, interlace and RRC list context are bypassed.
RequiredFix: Validate decoded field semantics in context, then materialize immutable assignment.

Description: Legacy study detector remains in adjacent production namespace.
TechnicalImpact: Strict code may import a study implementation.
RequiredFix: Move under +sixgr/+research/+pdcch and add strict dependency guard.

Description: Toolbox-backed PDCCH transmit kernels exist.
TechnicalImpact: Useful waveform foundation.
RequiredFix: Preserve as DUT adapter while correcting ownership and independent validation.

Description: Negative test concepts already exist.
TechnicalImpact: Useful starting point but statistically incomplete.
RequiredFix: Expand across formats, ALs, channels and confidence targets.

Description: PDCCH artifact exporter exists.
TechnicalImpact: Useful evidence surface.
RequiredFix: Replace mini-profile schemas with complete contracted outputs.

Description: Decoded-grant validation entry point exists.
TechnicalImpact: Useful integration seam.
RequiredFix: Make contextual and sole authority.

Description: Receiver uses candidate-space toolbox support.
TechnicalImpact: Useful candidate extraction foundation.
RequiredFix: Remove known-location fallback and independently verify enumeration.

Description: A PDCCH DM-RS component exists.
TechnicalImpact: Useful only if exact.
RequiredFix: Migrate exact parts into canonical strict package and independently validate.

Description: Configuration hashing exists.
TechnicalImpact: Useful for immutable assignment evidence.
RequiredFix: Extend to full DCI/CORESET/search-space/beam/BWP state digest.
